verdict.rationale: Slate's docs describe an interactive TUI (sessions, hotkeys, `/sessions`, `/workspace`, orchestration cards) and a `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flag for bypassing prompts, but nothing indicates a headless/non-interactive execution mode, CI integration, or scriptable exit-code output suitable for automation pipelines. Missing for 10: documented headless/print mode, CI usage examples, exit-code/stdout automation support, any mention of running without the TUI.
